   3| def ping(payload):
   4|     return {"ok": True}
   5| 
   6| def legacy_export(payload):
   7|     # DEPRECATED since 1.2: replaced by export_v2. Kept for old clients.
   8|     return {"format": "csv", "rows": payload.get("rows", [])}
   9| 
  10| def export_v2(payload):
  11|     return {"format": payload.get("format", "json"), "rows": payload.get("rows", [])}
  12|

  14|     # deprecated? see discussion in #250, some clients still call this
  15|     return {"count": len(payload.get("rows", []))}

  18|     "ping": ping,

  22| }
  23|
